name: Helsinki planner intent benchmark
description: Synthetic but realistic Helsinki requests for comparing local LLM providers. The fixed context keeps relative dates and selected map time reproducible.

cases.description: Uses the map centre when neither a place nor a time is supplied.
cases.message: I want a coffee and some sun nearby.

cases.description: Keeps an open-ended sun request at the current map context.
cases.message: Where can I catch some sun?

cases.description: Extracts an English venue anchor and a relative date.
cases.message: Sunny place near Storyville Töölö tomorrow at 1pm.

cases.description: Classifies lager as a bar request while keeping the Storyville anchor.
cases.message: I want a cold lager near Storyville tomorrow at 1pm.

cases.description: Treats a departure time as the end of the desired sun window.
cases.message: I am leaving Helsinki from Karhupuisto tomorrow at 2pm and want a lager before.

cases.description: Handles a same-day departure point and drinking request.
cases.message: I leave Kaivopuisto at 16 and want a beer in the sun before that.

cases.description: Maps after work to 18:00 on an explicit relative weekday.
cases.message: Coffee on Eerikinkatu this Friday after work.

cases.description: Extracts a neighbourhood and morning time.
cases.message: Morning coffee near Hakaniemi tomorrow at 9.

cases.description: Handles a weekend weekday name and noon.
cases.message: Find me coffee in Kallio on Saturday at noon.

cases.description: Uses a named venue as an anchor without an explicit time.
cases.message: I want a beer near Bar Mendocino.

cases.description: Treats tea as a cafe request.
cases.message: Tea near Oodi tomorrow at 15.

cases.description: Treats bakery as a cafe request.
cases.message: A bakery around Punavuori this Friday at 11.

cases.description: Does not mistake the word in for a location phrase.
cases.message: I am in a bad mood and need a refreshment.

cases.description: Keeps here as map-centre context instead of inventing a location.
cases.message: I just want a cold lager here.

cases.description: Tests a Finnish inflected area name and clock notation.
cases.message: Aurinkoinen kahvi lähellä Kamppia huomenna klo 14.

cases.description: Tests Finnish place inflection and a same-day time.
cases.message: Olut Kaivopuistossa tänään klo 17.

cases.description: Tests Finnish departure language and before semantics.
cases.message: Lähden Karhupuistosta huomenna klo 16 ja haluan lagerin ennen sitä.

cases.description: Tests an accented Finnish anchor in an English request.
cases.message: Coffee near Töölönlahti tomorrow after work.

cases.description: Uses a place anchor but leaves an unspecified time to the selected map time.
cases.message: I need a sunny place near Merihaka.

cases.description: Tests a half-hour clock value with an explicit Friday.
cases.message: Find a bakery around Kallio this Friday at 13:30.

cases.description: Separates location extraction from later place-search resolution.
cases.message: I want a beer near Eerikinpippuri tomorrow at 18.

cases.description: Uses a street address as the departure anchor.
cases.message: Before I leave from Bulevardi 20 at 15 tomorrow, I want coffee in the sun.

cases.description: Tests tonight and an explicit before-go deadline.
cases.message: Before I go to Storyville at 20 tonight, where can I have a drink?

cases.description: Tests a named venue with after-work shorthand.
cases.message: I want to catch some rays near Storyville tomorrow after work.

cases.description: Uses an explicit calendar date instead of relative date parsing.
cases.message: I want coffee near Hietalahti on 1 August at 12:45.

cases.description: Tests a same-day explicit clock time.
cases.message: Find a sunny place in Katajanokka at 17:00.

cases.description: Classifies cocktails as a bar request.
cases.message: Cocktails around Esplanadi tomorrow at 19.

cases.description: Tests a concise drinking request with no implied anchor.
cases.message: I just want a cold lager.

cases.description: Uses after-work time while retaining the current map centre.
cases.message: Coffee after work, please.

cases.description: Classifies wine as a bar request rather than a cafe request.
cases.message: Wine near Punavuori tomorrow at 18.

cases.description: Tests a venue-like anchor and weekday name.
cases.message: Coffee near Bar Eerikinkulma on Thursday at 10.
